entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Ignore all webpage UI. Three full body orthographic views on one wide canvas: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK, equal scale, feet on same baseline, neutral relaxed A pose, arms slightly apart, no perspective, no action. Preserve original short chibi proportions (about 2.3 heads tall), round cheeks, very long flowing silver-white hair with dark roots, two dark swept-back horns, long pointed ears, red-orange eyes, red diamond earrings, white petal-shaped outer gown over dark burgundy ruffled dress, black neck bow, dark boots. Separate small dark metallic dragon wing/blade ornaments at back; do not hide the body. Match clothing layers seen in reference; infer a coherent back and side, not an official design claim. Only labels FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK underneath, small footer 'Side and back are interpreted'. No extra characters, no extra costumes, no sexualization, no cropped head or feet. This sheet will guide a Blender low-poly chibi model; clarity and cross-view consistency are paramount.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production character turnaround sheet with corrected shoulder bag. Image 1 is the corrected Picora body, preserve this identity, palette, chibi scale, head silhouette and costume. Image 2 is the original design showing HOW the shoulder bag is worn. Image 3 is the isolated bag design; ignore its background haze. The small cream oval bag with pink curved front graphic, white wing/scallop upper trim, pink bow and double-cherry lower strap charm is on the character's anatomical LEFT hip (viewer RIGHT in a frontal view). A SINGLE narrow white strap passes over the SAME LEFT shoulder, straight down the side/front edge of the vest and behind the same arm to connect to the bag. It is a SAME-SIDE SHOULDER BAG, not crossbody; no diagonal across the chest, no backpack straps. The bag is small, approximately one quarter to one third the width of her head; it rests beside the skirt, not at knee height. Keep the cherries on the BAG strap only. Keep teal-white plaid skirt, pink vest/heart/bow, white sleeves, candy twin buns and curled side hair with ornaments, aqua-pink eyes, cheek heart, closed relaxed mouth, mismatched stockings/boots and white wing with teal bow on the striped-side boot. Original attached art has hand and hair occlusion; infer only enough hidden connections for a coherent 3D guide. Create ONE wide clean three-view sheet: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, BACK in that order. Orthographic full-body views at identical scale and aligned baseline, neutral relaxed A-pose, empty hands. Left side means a view of the character's anatomical LEFT side, the BAG SIDE; nose points to the LEFT of the page in this side view. Preserve the same costume and worn bag in all views. In the BACK view the bag must appear on page-LEFT, because it remains on anatomical left; show the back portion of its white same-shoulder strap, not an X or diagonal harness. Keep shoulder strap passing underneath hair where naturally occluded. The unobserved back of bag is plain cream with dusty-pink gusset, a minimal inferred construction, no invented front swirl on the back. Long loop of strap lies against the shoulder/body when worn, it must not arch above the head. No separate staff/weapon panel. Pale warm neutral solid background, crisp colored line art and restrained flat cel shading, no glow or shadows. Small exact title 'PICORA / SHOULDER BAG'. Exact view labels 'FRONT', 'LEFT SIDE', 'BACK'. Small exact footer 'Side and back are interpreted.' Spacious balanced layout, do not crop limbs or hair. This is a fan-game reference, not an official model sheet.
